name: Otozawa Kenji
source:
A friend of Makoto. They have been friends since childhood and have a close family relationship.

He used to have sex as a family. He takes pride in taking the place of his late father.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
